result.topic_en: A table, part 3, for numbers of the form 8n+3 (3, 11, 19, 43, 59, 67, 83): for each number it gives its representations as a sum of three squares ('Disc.'), the classes ('Cl.') with their character indices, and a list of numbers ('c:') belonging to each class.

methods.what: Representation of primes $p\equiv 3 \pmod 8$ as sums of three squares
Classification into classes (with indices) for each representation, listing numbers belonging to each class
Number of classes noted per entry (0,3 or 0.9) indicating class count 3 or 9
